hooks.command: file=/home/user/TravelPanel/TASKS.md; incomplete=$(grep -c "^\*\*Status\*\*: \`\[ \]\`" "$file" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); next=$(awk "/^### /{header=\$0} /\*\*Status\*\*: \`\[ \]\`/{print header; exit}" "$file" | sed "s/### //"); echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"TravelPanel — $incomplete tasks remaining. Next: $next — see TASKS.md for full queue.\"}"

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -q 'git commit'; then hash=$(git -C /home/user/TravelPanel log -1 --format='%h' 2>/dev/null); msg=$(git -C /home/user/TravelPanel log -1 --format='%s' 2>/dev/null); echo "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M') | $hash | $msg" >> /home/user/TravelPanel/SESSIONS.md; fi
